package main

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/xraph/bastion/security"
	"github.com/xraph/forge"
)

// This is a characterization of the pinned dependency, not an assertion that
// federation TLS is safe. A dependency fix must change this qualification.
func TestQualificationTLSReloadMissingCA(t *testing.T) {
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ca.pem")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("invalid CA"), 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	manager := security.NewTLSManager(security.TLSConfig{Enabled: true, CACertFile: path}, forge.NewNoopLogger())
	if err := os.Remove(path); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := manager.Reload(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("pinned behavior changed; requalify: %v", err)
	}
	if manager.GlobalTLSConfig().RootCAs != nil {
		t.Fatal("pinned behavior changed; requalify CA reload")
	}
	t.Log("UNSUPPORTED: missing private CA is silently replaced with system trust on reload")
}
